item.title: Here's when your Vivo smartphone will get OriginOS 7 update: check list of eligible devices, rollout schedule
item.description: Vivo shared its OriginOS 7 rollout phases for India, starting with the X300 series at the end of October.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G spotted on Google Play supported device list
item.content:encoded: A Google Play listing names the Galaxy F70 5G; it may be a rebadged Galaxy A17.

item.title: Vivo S2 FE vs POCO X8 Power: which 10,000mAh battery phone should you consider?
item.content:encoded: The Vivo S2 FE starts at Rs 38,999 while the POCO X8 Power starts at Rs 35,999.

item.title: Vivo X Fold 6 foldable phone launched in India with Dimensity 9500 Super Edition, 200MP camera: price, specifications
item.description: Vivo’s new foldable pairs a 200MP main camera with a 6,900mAh battery.
item.content:encoded:
• Vivo X Fold 6 is priced at Rs 2,19,999 for the only 12GB + 512GB model
  • Sales begin October 13

It competes with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, which currently sells for less at Rs 1,94,999.

item.title: Xiaomi 18 Ultra reportedly cancelled over pricing concerns, camera specs leaked
item.description: A tipster claims Xiaomi shelved its triple-200MP camera flagship over cost.
item.content:encoded: The Xiaomi 17 Ultra currently costs Rs 1,39,999 in India; the leaked configuration was reportedly priced at about CNY 10,000, approximately Rs 1.4 lakh.

item.title: Vivo S2 FE with massive 10,000mAh battery, MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset, IP69 rating launched in India
item.description: Vivo has launched the S2 FE in India with a 10,000mAh battery and the Dimensity 7300e processor.
item.content:encoded:
The Vivo S2 FE starts at Rs 38,999 for 6GB + 128GB, while the 8GB + 128GB model is priced at Rs 42,999. Sale begins October 20 with up to 10 percent instant cashback on select bank cards.

It rivals the Redmi Note 17 Pro (Rs 36,999).

item.title: Vivo V80 launches in India with 7,200mAh battery, 50MP Zeiss cameras
item.content:encoded:
• Vivo V80 price in India starts at Rs 62,999.

The 8GB + 256GB model costs Rs 69,999 and the 8GB + 512GB version Rs 79,999.

item.title: OPPO Find X10 series confirmed to launch in India in the coming months
item.description: OPPO confirmed the India launch at MediaTek Tech Day; the Pro Max uses the Dimensity 9600 Pro.

item.title: Xiaomi festive sale offers revealed for smartphones, tablets, air purifiers and power banks: Xiaomi 17 to sell for Rs 59,999, air purifiers start at Rs 6,999
item.description: Xiaomi listed festive-season deal prices across its range.

item.title: GIGABYTE GS22F12I and GS27F16I FHD gaming monitors with up to 180Hz refresh rate launched in India
item.description: GIGABYTE has launched two budget gaming monitors in India. Prices start at Rs 5,750.
item.content:encoded:
The GS22F12I costs Rs 6,199, while the GS27F16I costs Rs 10,999.

For around Rs 6,300, the Acer EK240Y offers a larger IPS panel.

item.title: Realme P4s Lite 4G smartphone launched in India with a 7,000mAh battery
item.content:encoded:
• Realme P4s Lite is priced under Rs 20,000.

The Realme P4s Lite price in India starts at Rs 16,499 for the 4GB + 64GB variant; the 4GB + 128GB model costs Rs 18,499.

item.description: Vivo’s October 6 event will cover several devices.

item.description: Samsung’s first clip-on Galaxy Buds offer up to 9.5 hours of playback.
item.content:encoded: The Galaxy Buds On launch in South Korea on October 27 for KRW 299,000, around Rs 19,000. India pricing has not been announced.
